info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Education Enrollments Schedule-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Schedule API enables organizations to efficiently manage and create schedules for enrolling students in educational programs. This API allows users to submit bulk enrollment requests, streamlining the process and ensuring that educational institutions can handle large volumes of enrollment data effectively. Typical consumers include school administrators and program coordinators who require an integrated solution for scheduling enrollments. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and improve student enrollment experiences.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to schedule a new enrollment by submitting the necessary details. Make sure to provide all required information to successfully create the enrollment schedule.

requestBody.description: This endpoint allows for the scheduling of enrollments based on the provided data in the request body. The client must include necessary details for the operation to be successful.
